name: IEEE Power and Energy Society home page: standards, journals and membership
title: IEEE Power and Energy Society home page: standards, journals and membership
answer: The IEEE Power and Energy Society home page is a membership and information page from a nonprofit, member driven organization focused on power and energy. Its most useful claim for standards watchers is that IEEE PES technical committee working groups have produced over 900 IEEE Standards and continue to produce nearly half of all IEEE Standards annually. The page also lists PES magazines, Transactions, the Open Access Journal of Power and Energy, events, a resource center and member benefits, but it does not discuss artificial intelligence or machine learning directly.

sections.body: This is the home page of the IEEE Power and Energy Society, published by IEEE PES. It describes the organization as a nonprofit, member driven body with a mission to be the leading provider of scientific and engineering information on power and energy worldwide. The page covers membership, events, publications, standards, a resource center and news. It carries a 2026 copyright notice, and the text was harvested on 26 September 2026. It is a navigational landing page rather than a technical report or standard.
sections.heading: What this source is

sections.body: The page presents IEEE PES as a nonprofit, member driven organization whose mission is to be the leading provider of scientific and engineering information on power and energy worldwide. It says IEEE PES events are open for registration to members and non-members, with members receiving reduced pricing on all conferences. It states that IEEE PES publishes leading magazines, IEEE PES Transactions, and the IEEE Open Access Journal of Power and Energy, and it notes a call for papers on electrical power and energy history, including local, regional and global advancements. Member benefits include reduced registration to all PES events and digital subscriptions to three leading IEEE PES magazines. The page says over 900 IEEE Standards have been produced by IEEE PES technical committee working groups, which continue to produce nearly half of all IEEE Standards annually. It describes the IEEE PES Resource Center as a digital library giving professionals and students access to technical reports, presentations and educational materials, with live and on demand content for CEUs and PDHs. It also mentions news on industry intelligence, trending technologies, standards and technical updates. Subscriptions to IEEE Power & Energy and IEEE Electrification magazines are complimentary with active IEEE PES memberships, including a Spanish translation of IEEE Power & Energy magazine. IEEE is described as a public charity and the world's largest technical professional organization dedicated to advancing technology for the benefit of humanity.
sections.heading: What it says

sections.body: The source states that IEEE PES technical committee working groups have produced over 900 IEEE Standards and continue to produce nearly half of all IEEE Standards annually. It says members receive digital subscriptions to three leading IEEE PES magazines and reduced registration to all PES events. It states that IEEE Power & Energy and IEEE Electrification magazine subscriptions are complimentary with active memberships, with IEEE Power & Energy magazine translated into Spanish. It describes IEEE as a public charity and the world's largest technical professional organization. It gives a 2026 copyright notice. It gives no figures on artificial intelligence, machine learning, grid cyber defense or distributed energy resource management.
sections.heading: Figures and claims worth noting

sections.body: A reader following AI in Energy would use this page mainly as a pointer to IEEE PES standards and publications, not as a source of AI specific findings. The page confirms that IEEE PES technical committee working groups produce a large share of IEEE Standards and that PES publishes journals, magazines and a resource center. Those channels are where standards and research relevant to power systems may appear, but this particular page does not name machine learning, grid cyber defense or distributed energy resource management. It is useful for understanding the organization and its outputs, and for finding events, publications and standards activity, but it does not itself describe AI applications in energy.
sections.heading: What it means for AI in Energy

sections.body: This is a home page, so it is partial and navigational. It does not provide technical detail, standards text, research findings or dates for specific publications. It does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, grid cyber defense or distributed energy resource management, despite the industry page point that cites it for those topics. The only date stated is a 2026 copyright notice, and the text was harvested on 26 September 2026. It is published by IEEE PES and serves membership, events and publication information, so it should not be treated as an independent or peer reviewed technical source.
